accordion.name: Accordion
accordion.description: A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each reveal a section of content.

aspect-ratio.name: Aspect Ratio
aspect-ratio.description: Responsive aspect-ratio wrapper that locks its children to a given proportion.

auto-complete.name: Auto Complete
auto-complete.description: Text input that suggests and lets users pick from a filtered list of options as they type.

avatar.name: Avatar
avatar.description: A visual representation of a user, typically displayed as a circular or rounded image with an optional fallback.

backdrop.name: Backdrop
backdrop.description: A blurred layer that sits behind overlays.

background.name: Background
background.description: Decorative background components for applying animated gradients and ambient color effects behind your UI.

badge.name: Badge
badge.description: Compact label used to display counts, statuses, or short pieces of metadata.

breadcrumb.name: Breadcrumb
breadcrumb.description: A horizontal trail of links that helps users understand and navigate the hierarchy of a site or app.

button.name: Button
button.description: Pressable control used to trigger actions or events, with support for visual variants, sizes, and loading states.

button-group.name: Button Group
button-group.description: Layout helper that visually groups adjacent `Button` instances, merging borders and radii for horizontal or vertical toolbars while keeping each button focusable.

calendar.name: Calendar
calendar.description: Month-grid date picker supporting single-date or date-range selection.

card.name: Card
card.description: Layout wrapper used to display content in a card format.

carousel.name: Carousel
carousel.description: Slideshow container that reveals one slide at a time, with optional looping and autoplay.

checkbox.name: Checkbox
checkbox.description: A square box that users can check or uncheck to represent boolean choices or multi-select lists.

click-away-listener.name: Click Away Listener
click-away-listener.description: Click away listener that uses a unique data-click-away-id for outside click detection.

collapsible.name: Collapsible
collapsible.description: A single section that expands or collapses to reveal or hide content.

container.name: Container
container.description: Layout wrapper used to arrange and align content.

date-time-picker.name: Date Time Picker
date-time-picker.description: Popover-based control for selecting a date, or a date and time.

dialog.name: Dialog
dialog.description: A window overlaid on the current page that focuses the user on a specific task or piece of information.

dropdown-menu.name: Dropdown Menu
dropdown-menu.description: A menu that appears when a user interacts with a trigger, typically used for contextual actions and navigation.

empty.name: Empty
empty.description: Placeholder for lists, tables, or pages with no content to display.

file-input.name: File Input
file-input.description: File input that supports click-to-select and drag-and-drop with validation.

floating-action-button.name: Floating Action Button
floating-action-button.description: Fixed-position circular button used to surface a page's primary action.

focus-trap.name: Focus Trap
focus-trap.description: Focus management utility that traps keyboard focus within its children, restores the previously focused element on cleanup, and guards against focus escaping via mouse or script.

gallery.name: Gallery
gallery.description: Grid or masonry gallery of image thumbnails that opens a full-screen, navigable lightbox.

highlight.name: Highlight
highlight.description: Text helper that visually emphasizes matches within content, often used for search results.

hover-card.name: Hover Card
hover-card.description: A small floating panel that reveals supplemental content when users hover or focus a trigger element.

icons.name: Icons
icons.description: Small reusable icon components, including controls like the password show/hide toggle and directional arrows.

image.name: Image
image.description: Enhanced image primitives for displaying pictures with optional progressive loading and performance-friendly defaults.

indicators.name: Indicators
indicators.description: Small visual markers, such as asterisks, used to call out required or special fields in forms.

input.name: Input
input.description: Single-line text field for capturing short pieces of information such as names, emails, or search queries.

input-otp.name: Input OTP
input-otp.description: Group of single-character inputs for entering one-time passcodes.

keyboard-shortcut.name: Keyboard Shortcut
keyboard-shortcut.description: Invisible helper that turns the nearest actionable wrapper it is nested inside into a keyboard shortcut target, and renders a visual key hint.

label.name: Label
label.description: Text caption that describes and links to a form control, often showing required or validation state.

link.name: Link
link.description: A navigational element that takes users to another page, view, or section when activated.

list.name: List
list.description: A semantic container for ordered or unordered groups of related list items.

list-item.name: List Item
list-item.description: A single item inside a list, typically representing one entry in a collection of related content.

loader.name: Loader
loader.description: Visual indicator that communicates to users that content or actions are in progress.

pagination.name: Pagination
pagination.description: Navigation region for moving between pages of content.

popover.name: Popover
popover.description: A floating panel anchored to a trigger element, used to display contextual content without blocking the rest of the page.

portal.name: Portal
portal.description: Mechanism for rendering content into a different part of the DOM tree, often used for overlays and dialogs.

progress.name: Progress
progress.description: Horizontal bar that communicates the completion progress of a task.

radio.name: Radio
radio.description: Single-selection form control typically used in groups where only one option can be active at a time.

rating.name: Rating
rating.description: Star-based input for collecting or displaying a rating, with optional half-icon precision.

resizable.name: Resizable
resizable.description: Panel layout whose regions can be resized by dragging handles between them.

scroll-area.name: Scroll Area
scroll-area.description: Scrollable region with a thin, theme-aware scrollbar that preserves native scroll and keyboard behavior.

select.name: Select
select.description: A dropdown control for choosing one or more options from a list, with an optional searchable variant.

separator.name: Separator
separator.description: Thin rule used to visually divide groups of content or UI controls.

sheet.name: Sheet
sheet.description: A panel that slides in from the edge of the screen to display contextual content without leaving the current page.

skeleton.name: Skeleton
skeleton.description: Placeholder UI used to represent content that is still loading.

slider.name: Slider
slider.description: Pointer and keyboard accessible control for selecting a single value or a range along a track.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: Composition utility that merges its props onto a single child element.

stats.name: Stats
stats.description: Compact metric display for dashboards, showing a label, value, and optional trend indicator.

switch.name: Switch
switch.description: A two-state toggle used for turning a setting or feature on and off.

table.name: Table
table.description: A tabular data structure that organizes information into rows and columns.

tabs.name: Tabs
tabs.description: A set of stacked triggers that switch between different views or panels in the same space.

text.name: Text
text.description: Typography primitive for rendering semantic headings, paragraphs, and inline text.

text-style.name: Text Style
text-style.description: Inline text formatting primitives for emphasizing, underlining, or annotating existing content.

textarea.name: Textarea
textarea.description: Multiline text field for collecting longer free-form input such as comments, notes, or descriptions.

timeline.name: Timeline
timeline.description: Visual representation of a sequence of events or steps in a process.

toast.name: Toast
toast.description: Display notifications via imperative API. Use Toaster + toast.success() etc.

toggle.name: Toggle
toggle.description: A pressable control that switches between on and off states, similar to a button with persistent pressed state.

tooltip.name: Tooltip
tooltip.description: A brief, non-interactive label that appears on hover or focus to describe another element.

virtualizer.name: Virtualizer
virtualizer.description: Headless sliding-window virtualizer that reports which items to mount so massive collections stay performant in any layout (list, grid, and beyond).

visually-hidden.name: Visually Hidden
visually-hidden.description: Utility for content that should be available to screen readers but not visible on screen.

avatar-module.name: AvatarModule
avatar-module.description: Composed avatar with image, initials fallback, and stable color derived from the display name.

button-module.name: ButtonModule
button-module.description: Ready-to-use button compositions for copy-to-clipboard and download feedback states.

input-module.name: InputModule
input-module.description: Composed input with label, validation message, and optional password visibility toggle.
